---
# ------------------------------
# 文档元数据 (Metadata)
# ------------------------------
title: "MathPhysCS CodeLab"          # 1. 页面主标题
author: "Rong-Kang Zhang"            # 2. 作者姓名
date: last-modified                  # 3. 自动使用文件最后修改时间作为页面日期
abstract: >                          # 4. 摘要，描述页面用途和内容
  A dynamic index of my <em>CodeLab</em> experiments created while delving into core and frontier topics in mathematics of computation and mathematics of machine learning.
  Each entry links to a self-contained, reproducible notebook, where I primarily use Haskell alongside other practical category theory-focused programming languages (e.g., Idris, Agda, OCaml).
  These notebooks integrate theoretical exposition with runnable code, demonstrating a complete workflow from theory to practice: theory $\rightarrow$ derivation $\rightarrow$ code implementation & visualization.
  All notebooks are live-rendered with Quarto, version-controlled on GitHub,
  and additionally compiled to PDF for offline reading.

# ------------------------------
# 页面布局与样式 (Layout & Style)
# ------------------------------
page-layout: full                    # 5. 使用全屏宽度布局
toc: false                           # 6. 不生成目录

# ------------------------------
# 核心功能：动态内容列表 (Listing)
# ------------------------------
listing:
  contents: "*/index.qmd"            # 7. 数据源：所有子目录下的 index.qmd 文件
  type: table                        # 8. 列表类型：表格
  date-format: "YYYY-MM-DD"          # 9. 日期显示格式：年-月-日
  
  # [兼容性调整] 使用 'fields' 来定义表格列
  # 它不支持重命名，但兼容性最好
  fields:
    - title
    - overall-category
    - file-modified
    - author

  # [修正点] 'filter-ui' 使用字段名列表（字符串数组）
  filter-ui:
    - title
    - overall-category
    - author
    
  # 定义默认的排序规则
  sort:
    - "weight asc"
    - "title asc"
    - "file-modified desc"
    
  sort-ui: true                      # 允许用户点击列标题进行排序
  table-striped: true                # 表格添加斑马纹样式，提升可读性
  page-size: 30                     # 表格分页，每页显示30条记录
---

<!-- 引入 Font Awesome 图标库 -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.5.1/css/all.min.css">

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon="true"}
# Navigate & Run

- **Open Notebooks**: Click any row in the table below to open the live notebook (supports R / Python / Julia / Haskell).  
- **Online Execution**: Launch the entire CodeLab environment via Binder (no local setup required):  
  [![Binder](https://mybinder.org/badge_logo.svg)](https://mybinder.org/v2/gh/rongkang-zhang/homepage/HEAD?urlpath=lab)  
*Note: Binder may take 1-2 minutes to load the environment.*
- **Offline Access**: PDFs of all notebooks are auto-built on [Overleaf](https://www.overleaf.com/read/your-project) and synced to GitHub after every update—ensure full reproducibility and offline reading.  

**Table Columns**:  
- `Notebook Title`: Name of the experiment (links to live notebook).  
- `Last Updated`: Timestamp of the latest revision (prioritize recent content).  
- `Author`: Contributor(s) to the notebook (for collaboration tracking).  
:::

<script>
// 为表格行添加点击事件，使其可跳转，并添加悬停效果
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  // 更精确地选择表格，避免页面上其他表格被误影响
  const table = document.querySelector('#lab-table + .listing-table');
  if (!table) return; // 如果表格不存在，则退出

  const rows = table.querySelectorAll('tbody tr');
  rows.forEach(row => {
    // 明确查找标题列中的链接，这通常是第一个 <a> 或者在特定列中
    const titleLink = row.querySelector('td:first-child a'); 
    if (titleLink) {
      // 添加点击事件
      row.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        // 防止点击链接本身时触发两次跳转
        if (event.target.tagName !== 'A') {
          window.open(titleLink.href, '_blank');
        }
      });
      // 添加 CSS 类以提供视觉反馈（需要在 SCSS 中定义）
      row.classList.add('clickable-row');
    }
  });
});
</script>
